environment.description: Same container image deployed on hardened RHEL 9.3 node pool with SELinux in enforcing mode. The pod is annotated with a custom SELinux type `container_migrator_t` defined in a CIL module loaded via `semodule`. The policy type-transitions constrain the process domain such that: (1) file read access is limited to objects labeled `migration_data_t` (applied only to /opt/app/migrations/*.xml files via fcontext rules), (2) network connect permission is restricted to `postgresql_port_t` (5432/tcp) only — no outbound HTTP/HTTPS/DNS resolution for entity fetching, (3) the `container_migrator_t` domain has no `read` permission on `etc_t`, `shadow_t`, `passwd_file_t`, `sysfs_t`, or any type outside the explicit allow set. The fcontext rule `semanage fcontext -a -t migration_data_t '/opt/app/migrations(/.*)?'` combined with `restorecon` ensures only migration directory contents are readable. The CIL policy additionally includes `(neverallow container_migrator_t file_type (file (read))) ` with explicit exceptions only for `migration_data_t` and `container_file_t` (the application binary itself).

config.neverallow_rules: neverallow container_migrator_t ~{migration_data_t container_file_t lib_t locale_t ld_so_cache_t} (file (read open getattr))
